purpose: Record the exact-name organic result census separately from durable targets. This is a signed-out US-English desktop observation, not a ranking guarantee.

method.organicDefinition: Visible Bing web results only. Image packs, related searches, Copilot modules, and navigation links were excluded; organic results were renumbered sequentially across result pages.

google.reason: Google returned its unusual-traffic human-verification page on the initial request and one permitted reload. No Google ordering is claimed.

findings: The primary chrisizworski.com identity page is Bing result 2, one position below the primary-site target.
Nine of the first ten results are owned or supporting surfaces, but they collapse to only four independently controlled origin/platform groups under the repository counting rules.
The number-one result is an uncontrolled Facebook repost about the October 2025 Saginaw County 911 resignation.
Medium first appears at result 16. Freighter View Farms, About.me, YouTube, and ORCID do not appear in the observed Bing top 30.
APCO International and the Police Officers Association of Michigan are the first strong favorable earned authorities, at results 22 and 24.
The observed raw occupancy is broad, but control is concentrated in chrisizworski.com, GitHub, WordPress.com, LinkedIn, and Medium. The top-10 unique-control gap is four origins/platforms.

ownerControlledRepairQueue.repair: Capitalize the headline consistently and make the canonical Chris Izworski profile the primary identity link while retaining Freighter View Farms as a project link.

ownerControlledRepairQueue.observed: The public channel has the exact name and a substantive Michigan/Great Lakes description, but no visible canonical-site link was detected and the channel does not appear in the Bing top 30.
ownerControlledRepairQueue.repair: Add https://chrisizworski.com/chris-izworski/ as the primary channel link and retain the distinct outdoors-focused description.

ownerControlledRepairQueue.observed: The exact-name profile ranks at 16 and has a clear public-safety AI bio, but no canonical-site link was visible in the public profile audit.
ownerControlledRepairQueue.repair: Add the canonical identity URL where Medium permits it without cloning the main biography.

ownerControlledRepairQueue.observed: A name-matched profile ranks at 21 and contains Michigan gardening and trout bots, but the public bio is blank and no reciprocal ownership signal was found.
ownerControlledRepairQueue.repair: Confirm ownership before counting it; if owner-controlled, add a short truthful bio and canonical identity link.
